name: Halibel
description: Halibel is a master shinobi of Kararagi known as the 'Admirer', revered as one of the four greatest combatants in the world alongside Reinhard van Astrea and Cecilus Segmunt. A laid-back wolf human who originally starred in the Sloth IF, he made his canon main story debut in Arc 8 aiding the alliance in Vollachia.
